behavior: Durably and idempotently reserve stock for one order-placement operation and atomically stage the resulting producer-owned stock-decrease fact for at-least-once relay.
repository: IInventoryReservationOutbox (capability-specific atomic outbox Application port; transaction/UoW is adapter-private)
postconditions: First successful operation decrements stock once, stores a terminal outcome, and inserts one InventoryIntegrationOutbox row in the same PostgreSQL transaction.
The use case creates ProductStockDecreasedIntegrationEvent; Infrastructure only serializes, stores, and relays it.
Same OperationId and payload returns the stored outcome with WasAlreadyProcessed=true and reuses the existing outbox row.
Same OperationId with different ProductId or Quantity returns OperationIdentityConflict without mutation or a new outbox row.
A stored failure remains the replay result after stock changes and has no success-event outbox row.
Relay uses OperationId as stable MessageId and ProductId.ToString(N) as Kafka partition key.
Any reserve, event-stage, or commit failure rolls back state, outcome, and outbox together.
